statement: When concluding an employment contract the employer must specify wages, prescribed working hours, the Article 55 weekly holiday, Article 60 annual paid leave, and the other decree-listed working conditions, and must deliver to the worker a written statement (electronic documents included) of the wage composition, calculation method and payment method, the prescribed working hours, holidays and annual leave; the specification duty applies again when any of those terms change (Labor Standards Act Article 17).
caveat: Where a change comes from a collective agreement or rules-of-employment amendment, re-delivery is due on the worker’s request (Article 17(2) proviso). Employers with 10 or more workers also prepare and file rules of employment under Article 93, and several neighboring Labor Standards Act duties gate on the five-worker threshold.
